title: Culturally Aware and Adapted NLP: A Taxonomy and a Survey of the State of the Art
reasoning: The paper explicitly includes 'Norms & Morals' as a primary category in its proposed cultural taxonomy. It surveys and categorizes extensive existing research that benchmarks moral reasoning, ethical judgments (e.g., normative vs. descriptive morality), and religious/social norms in NLP models, as detailed in Section 3.1.4 and Table 1.
